name: Figma
description_en:
Figma provides collaborative design files, reusable UI systems and interactive prototypes, with separate products for code generation, developer handoff and other creative work.

For a UX team, the purchase decision depends on who needs to edit, inspect or comment, which plan can publish shared resources, and how AI usage and training settings are administered.
description_zh:
Figma 提供协作设计文件、可复用 UI 系统和交互原型，并以不同产品覆盖代码生成、开发交接及其他创作任务。

UX 团队选购时，需要区分编辑、检查和评论角色，核对共享资源发布权限，以及 AI 用量和训练设置的管理方式。

core_features.explanation_en: Styles, components, variables and modes organize reusable design decisions; publishing and organizational controls vary by plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 样式、组件、变量和模式用于复用设计决策；发布与组织控制随套餐变化。

core_features.explanation_en: The product documents interactive flows, animation, Dev Mode inspection and MCP/Code Connect design context. These do not establish tested production code quality.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品记录交互流程、动画、Dev Mode 检查，以及 MCP/Code Connect 设计上下文；这些不证明生产代码质量已实测。

core_features.name_en: Seat credits and pooled AI add-ons
core_features.name_zh: 席位点数与共享 AI 附加包
core_features.explanation_en: AI terms distinguish personal seat credits from pooled subscription credits and usage billed after those allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: AI 条款区分个人席位点数、共享订阅点数和额度用完后的按量计费。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter free. Displayed Professional Full/Dev/Collab USD 16/12/3 monthly rates; selected billing configuration unconfirmed. Annual Organization 55/25/5 and Enterprise 90/35/5 monthly equivalents. AI seat credits, pooled add-ons and PAYG are separate and do not roll over.

sections.title_en: Build a flow around reusable decisions
sections.title_zh: 围绕可复用决策构建设计流程
sections.en:
Figma Design combines canvas editing, layout and type controls with multiplayer files and comments. A reusable interface can use components for repeated elements, styles for visual decisions and variables/modes for coordinated values or themes. The pricing documentation also describes overlays, transitions and advanced animation for interactive prototypes. A hypothetical checkout flow can therefore communicate states and interactions before implementation.

A useful editorial sequence is to identify repeated UI, define component states, connect the core path, then review error and empty states with stakeholders. A prototype demonstrates intended behavior; it does not supply evidence that representative users can complete the task. Participant recruitment, research consent and study interpretation still need an appropriate research workflow. No design file, participant study or component-to-code execution was tested here.
sections.zh:
Figma Design 将画布编辑、布局和文字控制与多人文件、评论结合。可复用界面可通过组件表达重复元素，通过样式统一视觉决策，通过变量/模式管理数值或主题。价格文档还描述了交互原型的叠加层、过渡和高级动画。因此，假设的结账流程可在实现前表达状态和交互。

编辑建议是先识别重复 UI、定义组件状态、连接核心路径，再与相关人员检查错误和空状态。原型展示的是预期行为，不能证明有代表性的用户能完成任务。参与者招募、研究同意和结果解释仍需要相应研究流程。本研究未测试设计文件、参与者研究或组件到代码的执行。

sections.title_en: Choose access for the work each person performs
sections.title_zh: 按每个人实际工作选择访问权限
sections.en:
The current pricing page offers Starter plus Professional, Organization and Enterprise, and separately lists Full, Dev and Collab seats. Its displayed Professional rates were USD 16/12/3 per month for those seat types, with monthly/annual billing choices; the final selected billing configuration requires confirmation. Organization explicitly lists annual billing at USD 55/25/5 monthly equivalents, and Enterprise USD 90/35/5. These are seat-specific rates, not a universal price for every teammate.

The page says paid plans can allow viewing and commenting without additional purchased seats. Professional emphasizes one-team files, projects and libraries; Organization adds shared resources and centralized administration across teams; Enterprise adds workspaces, theming/APIs and SCIM seat management. Beta access is product and seat specific: Motion and Sites are listed for Full seats, Specs for paid seats and Buzz for all seats. Check the exact action and product a collaborator needs before granting a paid editing role.
sections.zh:
现行价格页提供 Starter、Professional、Organization 和 Enterprise，并分别列出 Full、Dev、Collab 席位。Professional 页面显示三类席位每月 USD16/12/3，并提供月付/年付选择；最终选中的账期配置仍需确认。Organization 明确标注年付，月均 USD55/25/5；Enterprise 为 USD90/35/5。这些是各席位价格，不是所有成员统一单价。

页面说付费套餐可让他人查看和评论，无需额外购买席位。Professional 重点是单团队文件、项目和资源库；Organization 增加跨团队共享资源及集中管理；Enterprise 增加工作区、主题/API 和 SCIM 席位管理。Beta 访问按产品及席位区分：Motion、Sites 列为 Full，Specs 为付费席位，Buzz 为全部席位。授予付费编辑角色前，应先核对成员实际需要的动作和产品。

sections.title_en: AI budgets have three separate layers
sections.title_zh: AI 预算分为三个层次
sections.en:
Starter lists 150 AI credits per day, capped at 500 per month. Full seats list 3,000 monthly credits on Professional,3,500 on Organization and 4,250 on Enterprise; Dev and Collab list 500. Under the June 24,2026 AI terms, seat credits belong to the individual user, reset monthly and cannot be shared. Optional AI-credit subscriptions create a team/organization pool, followed by PAYG usage if enabled. Consumption normally proceeds seat credits, pooled credits, then PAYG. Credits expire at month end without rollover.

Professional add-on credit subscriptions renew monthly even if the underlying Professional plan is annual. Organization/Enterprise add-ons align to the annual term, are billed upfront and replenish monthly. PAYG is billed in arrears and can be enabled, disabled or budgeted in the admin dashboard; upgrading the credit subscription does not erase already-incurred PAYG charges. Budget review should therefore include both recurring seats and potential consumption across authorized users. Exact per-action generation costs were not measured.
sections.zh:
Starter 列出每天 150 点 AI 额度、每月上限 500 点。Full 席位在 Professional、Organization、Enterprise 分别列出每月 3,000、3,500、4,250 点，Dev 和 Collab 为 500 点。按 2026 年 6 月 24 日 AI 条款，席位点数归个人，每月重置且不可共享。可选 AI 点数订阅形成团队/组织共享池，启用 PAYG 后才会产生后续按量使用。通常按个人席位、共享池、PAYG 的顺序消耗，月底到期，不结转。

即使底层 Professional 为年付，其附加点数订阅仍按月续费。Organization/Enterprise 附加包与年期对齐，预付并每月补充。PAYG 后付费，可在管理后台启停及设置预算；升级点数订阅不会清除已产生的 PAYG 费用。因此预算应同时包含固定席位和所有授权用户可能产生的用量。具体每项生成操作成本未测量。

sections.title_en: Read the training control as a prospective setting
sections.title_zh: 将训练开关理解为面向后续内容的设置
sections.en:
The AI terms treat inputs and outputs as Customer Content and say the customer retains its rights as between itself and Figma. When Content Training is enabled, Figma may use customer content to improve its products through model training. If an administrator later switches it off, the clause says new content and edits added after that date will not be used for model training. It does not promise retroactive untraining of earlier material. The actual setting and plan defaults for a particular workspace were not inspected.

The same terms require human evaluation of AI outputs and relevant clearances rather than guaranteeing accuracy or non-infringement. They expressly exclude the standalone Figma Weave platform from their scope. Review confidential source material, plugin permissions and the exact AI product before bringing customer assets into a workflow; no account setting was changed and no content was uploaded.
sections.zh:
AI 条款将输入和输出视为 Customer Content，并表示在用户与 Figma 之间，用户保留相关权利。Content Training 开启时，Figma 可将客户内容用于模型训练以改进产品。管理员之后关闭时，条款约束的是该日期之后新增的内容和编辑，不承诺对早先材料追溯取消训练。本研究未检查具体工作区的实际开关或套餐默认值。

同一条款要求人工评估 AI 输出并取得相关许可，不保证准确或不侵权，并明确排除独立 Figma Weave 平台。将客户素材带入工作流前，应检查保密材料、插件权限及具体 AI 产品。本研究未修改账户设置，也未上传内容。

sections.title_en: Handoff and procurement need the right agreement
sections.title_zh: 交接与采购需要对应协议
sections.en:
Figma’s legal overview and March 11,2026 Terms of Service distinguish Starter/Professional from Organization/Enterprise, which use a Software Services Agreement. The reviewed terms grant conditional access for internal purposes; they do not transfer ownership of the platform or clear third-party Community files, plugins, fonts and component libraries. Those resources have their own applicable terms.

For a delivery decision, validate the actual target file’s component mapping, Dev Mode access, exported assets and generated code against the project’s requirements. This profile establishes documented capability and current listed commercial structure. It does not verify a subscription, security certification, plugin integration, generated implementation or deployed website.
sections.zh:
Figma 法律概览及 2026 年 3 月 11 日服务条款，将 Starter/Professional 与采用 Software Services Agreement 的 Organization/Enterprise 区分。已读条款授予附条件的内部用途访问权，不转让平台所有权，也不清除第三方 Community 文件、插件、字体和组件库的许可要求，这些资源有各自适用条款。

决定交付时，应按项目要求验证目标文件的组件映射、Dev Mode 权限、导出素材和生成代码。本记录建立的是文档功能和当前列出的商业结构，未验证订阅、安全认证、插件集成、生成实现或部署网站。
